experiment: explicit BM face-energy coupling on a tyssue vertex sheet

neighbour_coupling_gradient.note: stiffness 0 (soft) -> high (stiff) across x; smooth monotone field

verdict: A stiff/slow BM confines basal-area growth (gap 0.27 vs 0.00 free) and drives growing cell volume into cell height (+50% vs +10% free); the BM tension is continuous across cells (smooth stiffness-gradient field). Reduces to R1's prism law in the homogeneous limit.
